name: M5Stack AtomS3
description: 24 x 24 mm ESP32-S3FN8 cube with a 0.85-inch 128x128 IPS screen, MPU6886 IMU, IR LED, button and Grove port; a tiny USB-C display/IMU node, now end-of-life (successor AtomS3R).
notes: End-of-life per M5Stack, which recommends the AtomS3R (ESP32-S3-PICO-1-N8R8 with 8 MB PSRAM) as the replacement; AtomS3 Lite (no screen) is a cheaper sibling.
Exposes the HY2.0-4P Grove port plus a few GPIOs (G5-G8, G38, G39) on the bottom pins; GPIO count is approximate. Built-in 5 V to 3.3 V DC-DC. Native USB only (no UART bridge).
Peripheral limits assume only the exposed GPIOs (ADC1/touch pins G1, G2, G5-G8).
